auth.tagline: See what's happening around you. Right now.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to see what's happening nearby.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Join the vibes happening around you.
register.confirmationEmail: Check your email to confirm your account.

identity.title: Choose your Vibe identity
identity.description: Other people nearby do not need to know your real name. Use the name we generated for you or create your own.
identity.nameExplanation: This is the name people will see when you post or react to a Vibe.
identity.minimumLengthError: Your display name must contain at least 3 characters.

interests.title: What's your vibe?
interests.description: Choose at least {{count}} things you're into. Can't find something? Add your own.

location.title: See what’s happening around you
location.description: VibeMoments uses your location to find Vibes happening nearby and to understand which moments are relevant to you.
location.privacyDescription: Other users will not see your live GPS position. Location is used to discover nearby Vibes and to attach approximate location information to moments you post.

uses.findNearby: Find Vibes within your local area

location.permissionRequired: Location permission is required to discover nearby Vibes.

error.title: Couldn't load nearby Vibes
error.fallback: Something went wrong while loading nearby Vibes.

empty.title: Nothing nearby yet
empty.description: There aren't any active Vibes within {{distance}} km. Be the first to share what's happening.

composer.title: Say something to {{name}}
composer.oneMessageDescription: If they reply within one hour, conversation unlocks. If they don't, this request expires and you can't contact them again through this Vibe.
composer.alreadyUsed: You've already used your connection request for this Vibe.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Requests and conversations started through nearby Vibes.

requests.emptyDescription: If someone swipes right on one of your Vibes and sends a message, it will appear here.

chats.emptyDescription: Conversations appear here after a Vibe creator replies to a connection request.

friendship.requestDescription: {{name}} would like to add you as a friend.

messages.emptyDescription: You connected through a Vibe. Messages between you will appear here.

capture.title: Create a Vibe
capture.description: Share what's happening around you right now.
capture.cameraDescription: Take a photo or record a video
capture.explanation: Capture what's happening around you right now and share it with nearby people.

location.title: General area only
location.description: Only the district and city are shown. Your exact location remains private.

interests.title: Add interests
interests.description: Choose existing interests or create one if it's missing.
interests.maximum: You can attach up to {{count}} interests to a Vibe.

friends.title: Friends
friends.description: People you've connected with through real conversations.

error.title: Couldn't load your friends.
error.fallback: Something went wrong while loading your friends.

empty.title: No friends yet
empty.description: Keep talking with people you meet through Vibes. When a connection grows naturally, the option to become friends can appear.

identity.editDescription: This is how people see you around VibeMoments.
identity.bioPlaceholder: Tell people a little about yourself...

distance.title: Vibe distance
distance.description: Choose how far away Vibes can appear in your feed.
distance.ownVibesNotice: Your own active Vibes are always shown, even if they are outside this distance.

interests.title: Your interests
interests.description: Used to help match you with relevant Vibes.

account.title: Account
account.publicIdentityDescription: Your email is never shown on your public profile.

sharedInterests.title: Shared interests
sharedInterests.description: Things you both chose as part of your Vibe identity.

friendProfile.removeDescription: You'll no longer be friends, but your existing conversation and message history will stay intact.

profile.displayNameTooShort: Display name must be at least 2 characters.
profile.displayNameTooLong: Display name must be 40 characters or fewer.
profile.usernameTooShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
profile.usernameTooLong: Username must be 30 characters or fewer.
profile.usernameInvalid: Username can only contain letters, numbers and underscores.
profile.bioTooLong: Bio must be 160 characters or fewer.
profile.vibeDistanceRange: Vibe distance must be between 5 km and 25 km.
